priorFindings.title: socialize-debt forces unbounded LP loss
priorFindings.note: Any single authorized contract can call socialize-debt with an unbounded scaled-amount and NO precondition/cap, driving total-assets to 0 and annihilating LP redemption value while sBTC stays physically locked (redeem then reverts ERR-OUTPUT-ZERO). This is a real bug (a missing-precondition fault any one authorized market can trip), not merely a trust assumption.
